who we are ✦

ABOUT
LUCENT

"we don't make clothes for one type of person. we make clothes for every version of you."

lucent started because we got tired of brands that put you in a box. you're not just streetwear. you're not just luxury. you're not just vintage. you're all of it depending on the day, the mood, the moment.

every piece we make has a message on it for a reason. we want you to wear something that actually means something to you. not just a logo. not just a flex. something real.

we paint by hand. we limit every drop. we put thought into every detail. because if we're gonna make something, it better be worth wearing.
